name: Knowledge
description: Build a shared knowledge graph from tracker items
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.tagline: A shared vocabulary for team knowledge graphs
marketplace.longDescription: Knowledge teaches the agent how to set up and write a knowledge graph in your project: entities, claims, questions, findings, and investigations as tracker types, with a small set of verbs for statements. Setup also installs an editable "How we write this wiki" page that tells people and agents what belongs in the wiki. Graphs built this way stay consistent across projects and show up in the team wiki.
highlights: Standard tracker types for entities, claims, questions, findings, and investigations
A predicate registry for typed statements between entities
Guidance for writing claims with a stated basis and conditions
A wiki guide page your team can edit or replace, which the agent reads before writing

claudePlugin.description: Set up a team knowledge graph and wiki guide, then write to it with tracker types

enablement.purpose: Sort work events for the knowledge graph with TypeSafe's Jev model. Sends event text to api.typesafe.ai or your Cloudflare account's Workers AI only after you save a TypeSafe API key or Cloudflare token.
